MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 25
   C. 6
   D. 5

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

7. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 5
   C. 16
   D. 4

8. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 14
   C. 22
   D. 33

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44
   C. 22
   D. 105

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 18

17. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 45
   C. 36
   D. 18

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

20. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

21. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

22. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 49
   C. 43
   D. 31

23. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 13

24. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

25. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49

26. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)

28. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)

29. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21

   C. 9
   D. 1

30. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11
